h:
致力于https://comfy.civitai.com/

按照屏幕截图安装“Anima Safe PAG”扩展

然后下载 json 文件并将其拖到工作区中。
在字段中输入提示，然后点击顶部的蓝色“运行”按钮。
第一次下载模型需要一段时间（请参阅附图了解在哪里检查）。

将 PAG 'end' 设置设置为 0 以禁用，或者如果您希望能够比较 PAG 与无 PAG，则打开子图并禁用 PAG 节点。

*免责声明：我只是将 PAG 节点连接到 comfyui 中的基本 anima txt2img 工作流程 - 我没有进行扩展。本指南和 json 只是为了让不熟悉 comfyui 的人更轻松地访问尝试 PAG

o.en:
works onhttps://comfy.civitai.com/

Follow screenshots to install the 'Anima Safe PAG' extenstion

Then download and drag the json file into the workspace.
Type a prompt in the field and hit the blue RUN button at the top.
The models will take a while to download the first time (see attached image for where to check this).

set PAG 'end' setting to 0 to disable, or open the subgraph and disable the PAG node if you want to be able to compare PAG vs no PAG.

*DISCLAIMER: I simply wired in the PAG node to the basic anima txt2img workflow in comfyui - I didn't make the extension. this guide and json is simply to allow easier access to try out PAG for people unfamiliar with comfyui
